Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.

Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 0 Bank Select MSB Program, 6 Bank Select MSB Live, 3 Bank Select MSB Piano, 4 Bank Select MSB Sample, 32 Bank Select LSB, 64 Sustain, 11 Ctrl Pedal (Expression).

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same messages when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
